skills.name: Stardust Shock
skills.description: Cyclops casts two Stardust Disks in the target direction, each dealing 275<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in its path.
skills.tips: Use his first skill on creeps. This skill is mostly used for killing creeps/minions and killing running enemies.  Cyclops will shoot out planets to the specified target dealing the target 210 magic pts at the start.  Using this skill while clashing with enemies will reduce all skill cooldown allowing you to use your second skill faster as well as trapping running enemies with your ultimate.

skills.name: Planets Attack
skills.description: Cyclops conjures Starlit Spheres around himself while gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s. The spheres will automatically seek and attack nearby enemies (prioritizes enemy heroes), exploding on collision and dealing 200<font color='#27C0C7'>( +50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to the enemy. Enemies hit by multiple spheres will take reduced damage after the first hit.
skills.tips: This is the most powerful skill Cyclops has. Planets will start to surround Cyclops making nearby enemies target and dealing 210 damage pts each planet.  This is mostly used for finishing off enemies and damaging them. This is also used to and commonly used to stop/trap enemies from running away.

skills.name: Star Power Lockdown
skills.description: Cyclops creates a Planetary Sphere and sends it after the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 550<font color='#27C0C7'>( +220% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and immobilizing them for 1-2s (increases with travel distance).
skills.tips: As said in the first skill this is used to trap running enemies or just enemies.  Allowing you or your teammate to kill your enemy or simply finish them off if they have a low amount of health for this skill will follow wherever the enemy goes.  This can be countered by many heroes now so don't be too shabby while in a match.

skills.name: Starlit Hourglass
skills.description: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5s.
skills.tips: His passive allows all his skills to reduce 0.5 seconds upon hitting an enemy.  This passive is really strong and a cooldown+magic damage build will make Cyclops really Over Powered.

items.name: Enchanted Talisman
items.des: Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.des: Unique Passive - Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4s). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 3s.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: This build will give you a considerable amount of Magic Damage, Health, and Cooldown Reduction enough for you to be a king each game.
